title.en: AI capstone: a learning pipeline with mathematical checks
title.zh: AI 综合项目：具备数学检查的学习流程

lead.en: Implement the fixed synthetic classifier, verify its mathematics and numerical repairs, diagnose four required faults, and defend a frozen stratified evaluation with actual plots and outputs.
lead.zh: 实施固定合成分类器，验证数学及数值修复，诊断四故障，以实际图输出答辩冻结分层评估。

prerequisites.en: Modules 14, 18, 26, 27, 28, 29 and 30. Python 3.11+ and the pinned NumPy 1.26.4 CPU environment; no other numerical packages are needed.
prerequisites.zh: 需模块 14、18、26、27、28、29、30，Python 3.11+ 和固定 NumPy 1.26.4 CPU 环境，无其他数值包。

en: Reproduce the exact 1,000-row data and 600/200/200 stratified split.
Fit scaling and PCA only on training and inspect singular modes.
Derive mean Bernoulli loss, shapes, gradient and curvature.
Verify derivatives and repair scaling and finite-logit arithmetic.
Select a fixed grid on validation and diagnose all four required faults.
Defend frozen metrics, calibration, conditional uncertainty and a complete update trace.
zh: 复现精确千行数据及 600/200/200 分层。
仅训练拟合尺度 PCA，查奇异模态。
推均值 Bernoulli 损失、形状、梯度曲率。
检查导数，修尺度及有限 logit 算术。
验证选预先网格，诊断四故障。
答辩冻结指标校准、条件不确定及完整更新。

plotAlt.en: Executed selected-model training and validation NLL curves, five fixed-bin test calibration bars with counts, and log-scaled training singular values.
plotAlt.zh: 实际所选模型训练验证 NLL 曲线、五固定箱测试校准与计数，以及 log 轴训练奇异值。

text.en: Write the data, split and evaluation contract.
Generate, split and fit training-only scaling/PCA diagnostics.
text.zh: 生成拆分并做训练尺度 PCA 诊断。

text.en: Verify the manifest, hash, counts and singular modes.
text.zh: 验证清单 hash 计数及奇异模态。

text.en: Derive likelihood, objective, gradient, shapes and Hessian.
text.zh: 推似然目标梯度形状及 Hessian。

text.en: Implement stable loss and perform an independent derivative check.
text.zh: 实施稳定损失和独立导数检查。

text.en: Explain raw-step failure, scaling and PCA rank.
text.zh: 解释原始步长失败、尺度及 PCA 秩。

text.en: Fit the predeclared grid and compare validation/PCA/baseline.
text.zh: 拟合预先网格，比较验证 PCA 基线。

text.en: Demonstrate and repair all four mandatory faults.
Record frozen choices before final testing.
Evaluate fixed metrics, calibration and stratified uncertainty.
text.zh: 评固定指标校准及分层不确定。

text.en: Write the mathematical prediction/update trace and report.
text.zh: 写预测更新追踪及报告。

text.en: Assess artefacts and required leakage/derivative diagnoses.
text.zh: 评材料及必需泄漏导数诊断。
